{{Quote|We'll head for Nox. And remember Lok is mad and powerful. And Xesh. Both are unbalanced and neither is our friend. Good hunting. Hawk out.|[[Hawk Ryo]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Hunt for Xesh and Lok''' was started by the [[Je'daii Order]] when the fallen [[Je'daii Master]] [[Daegen Lok]] and the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] escaped from [[Bogan]] where they were exiles. In addition of the group of Je'daii sent after the two [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] users, the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] sent his own Force Hound after Xesh, [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]].
